  - paragraph: Clearing check-in
  - generic: +
  - generic: 0.0 m · 0 m/s · 0.2 s · ♥ 100

pause:
- link "Skip to flight selection":
  - /url: "#explore"
- dialog:
  - banner:
    - button "Menu"
    - generic: FPV SIM · Worlds
    - button "Resume"
  - paragraph: Clearing check-in
  - button "Arm / resume"
  - generic: +
  - generic: 0.0 m · 0 m/s · 0.3 s · ♥ 100
  - strong: 1/3 · Hold position
  - status: Paused. Arm deliberately to continue.
  - generic "Yaw 0%, Throttle 0%":
    - generic: Yaw / Throttle
    - status: 0% · held
  - generic "Roll 0%, Pitch 0%":
    - generic: Roll / Pitch
  - complementary "Drone response. Paused · actual pose retained vertical speed near zero. 0.0 m · +0.0 m/s vertical · 0.0 m/s drift":
    - button "Hide drone response": ×
    - status: Motors off · Drone upright
- status: Preparing flight…
- dialog "FPV / LINE":
  - heading "FPV / LINE" [level=1]:
    - img "FPV / LINE"
  - paragraph: FPV SIM · Worlds
  - navigation "Choose game mode":
    - navigation:
      - link "Solo":
        - /url: https://mekhovov.github.io/revealline/game/?lang=en
      - link "Versus":
        - /url: https://mekhovov.github.io/revealline/game/couch/?lang=en
      - link "Team":
        - /url: https://mekhovov.github.io/revealline/game/couch/relay-rescue.html?lang=en
      - button "FPV SIM"
      - link "Snake":
        - /url: https://mekhovov.github.io/revealline/game/snake/play.html?lang=en
  - paragraph: Clearing check-in
  - navigation "Main menu":
    - button "Continue" [active]
    - button "Select Mission"
    - button "Settings"
    - button "Full screen"
    - 'button "Sound: off"'
  - button "Retry"
  - paragraph: "Tab/arrows move; Enter selects; Esc goes back. Controller: release, then press/release A to connect. Calibrated radio: hold yaw right for 0.7 s, then centre to connect; roll/pitch move, hold yaw right/left then centre to confirm/go back."
limitations: Normal public render/arm/pause only; context-loss recovery qualified in admitted local player/editor. Not physical touch-device, offline or sustained FPS proof.
